Review (Opus, read-only): blockers

Head `98336943b`. I read the diff and the full `release.yml` at the head. I did not run a workflow.

## Blocker

1. **The planned dispatch cannot work as written.** GitHub runs a `workflow_dispatch` with the workflow file of the dispatched ref. The branch `site/v0.25.0` (head `3bc320a8c`) has the `release.yml` of tag v0.25.0. That file has no `inputs:` on `workflow_dispatch` (`.github/workflows/release.yml:29` on that branch) and no `if: ${{ !inputs.site_only }}` on any job.
   - `gh workflow run release.yml --ref site/v0.25.0 -f site_only=true` is refused with HTTP 422 (unexpected input `site_only`).
   - A dispatch on that ref without `-f` runs the old file: all platform builds (about 230 billed minutes, macOS 10x), and `pages` stays tag-only, so nothing deploys.
   - The PR body ("Not exercised") and `docs/decisions/3271-site-redeploy.md:17` name this dispatch as the plan.

   Required change: put the same `release.yml` change on `site/v0.25.0` before the dispatch. The `release.yml` of v0.25.0 is identical to the base of this PR (`git diff v0.25.0 origin/main -- .github/workflows/release.yml` is empty), so `git cherry-pick 98336943b` (or a copy of only the `release.yml` hunk) applies cleanly there. A push to `site/v0.25.0` starts no workflow (the push trigger is tags only). Then update the decision file and the PR body: the plan has a step "apply the workflow commit to `site/v0.25.0`", and the dispatch comes after it. Alternative: merge this PR first and dispatch from a `site/*` branch that is made from v0.25.0 plus this commit.

## Checks that pass

- Triggers: only `push` of `v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.0` tags and `workflow_dispatch`. The new input is on the existing `workflow_dispatch` only (`release.yml:34-39`). No `pull_request`, `pull_request_target` or `schedule`. No fork path. All jobs are GitHub-hosted. No permission or secret is widened: `pages` keeps `pages: write` and `id-token: write`, `publish` keeps `contents: write`.
- Job trace, three cases:

  | Job | Tag push | Dispatch, no input | Dispatch, `site_only` true |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | linux, macos, windows, wasm | run (`inputs.site_only` is null, `!null` is true) | run (`false`) | skipped |
  | aur, snap, flatpak | follow linux | follow linux | skipped (linux skipped) |
  | publish | runs | skipped (not a tag) | skipped on a branch |
  | site | runs | runs | runs (`!cancelled()`, wasm skipped) |
  | pages | site and publish success | skipped | only from `refs/heads/site/*` |

  The tag path and the plain dispatch path are the same as before.
- With `wasm` skipped, `WASM_RESULT` is `skipped`. The site step writes `app = false`, prints the warning, and Zola writes app/ as the "not part of this copy" page. The version comes from `[workspace.package]` of the checked-out tree. The tag-name check runs only when `GITHUB_REF_TYPE` is `tag`.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test release_site_tests` in a detached worktree of the head (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`): 2 passed. The worktree is removed. The new test pins the trigger list, the input, each job condition, and the two branches of the `pages` condition as text. It does not evaluate the expressions. That is sufficient for a contract test.
- The PR body has `Process change: yes` and `Refs #3276` with no closing keyword. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. `Changelog: none` is correct for a CI-only change.
- The decision file has the decided, why, dropped and cost-to-change parts of `docs/decisions/README.md`.

## Notes (not blockers)

- A `site_only` dispatch on a future tag ref (for example `--ref v0.26.0 -f site_only=true`) starts `publish`, because its condition reads only the ref. The guard "At least one asset to publish" then fails, so no release page changes and `pages` is skipped. Add `!inputs.site_only` to the `publish` condition, or say in the decision file that `site_only` is for `site/*` branches only. Then the sentence "A site_only run cannot make a release page" is true without the guard.
- The decision file name is `3271-...` but its heading is `## #3276`. The README format is `<issue>-<slug>.md` for the issue of the PR. The name follows the plan on #3276, so this is acceptable. `3276-site-redeploy.md` agrees better with the README.
- The owner action (deployment branch policy `site/*` on `github-pages`) is still necessary after the fix above.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b05a95c3906893d14cf156be6d66cd814dad89ef -->
Delta re-check (Opus, read-only): clean

Delta `98336943b..b05a95c39`, one commit. The earlier review is at head `98336943b`. I did not run a workflow.

## The blocker is fixed

- `origin/site/v0.25.0` has head `e41d7129f`. That head is one commit, `ci(release): site_only dispatch (from PR #3277)`, on top of `3bc320a8c`.
- `git rev-parse` gives the same blob for the two copies of `.github/workflows/release.yml`: `cae3c434a`, at `b05a95c39` and at `e41d7129f`. The two files are byte-identical. The planned dispatch on `site/v0.25.0` thus reads the `site_only` input and the new job conditions.
- `git diff v0.25.0 origin/site/v0.25.0 --stat` touches only `site/`, `docs/decisions/3271-site-test-drift.md` and `.github/workflows/release.yml`. It has no app code and no Cargo files, so the site version stays 0.25.0.
- The decision file and the PR body now state the step "the same `release.yml` goes on `site/v0.25.0` before the dispatch".

## The notes are fixed

- `publish` now has `!cancelled() && !inputs.site_only && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')`. A `site_only` dispatch on a tag ref does not publish. A tag push has a null input, and `!null` is true, so the tag path is the same as before. The test pins the new condition text.
- The decision file is renamed to `docs/decisions/3276-site-redeploy.md`, and the comment in `release.yml` names the new path.

## Test

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo test -p xtask --test release_site_tests` in a detached worktree of `b05a95c39`: 2 passed. I removed the worktree.

## Minor (no action necessary)

- The "Cost to change later" line of the decision file names "the `!inputs.site_only` term of `publish` and `pages`". In `pages` the term is `inputs.site_only`, not negated. The meaning is clear.
- If `release.yml` changes again on this PR, the same file must go on `site/v0.25.0` again before the dispatch. The PR body says this.
- The owner action is still necessary: the `site/*` deployment branch policy on `github-pages`.

Coordinator: `main` is green again (post-merge run 44986121542 on f4b351682), so the merge hold ends. This workflow PR merges on head b05a95c39. The reviews that this merge relies on are the Opus review (comment 7073397908) and its clean delta re-check on this head (comment 7073423666). The xtask test `release_site_tests` passes 2 of 2 on this head. It adds no new trigger. `publish` stays tag-only and is now also skipped on `site_only`. I flag it ready and merge it. Nothing is pushed after this flag. A `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows (xtask/). The dispatch stays held until the owner adds the `site/*` branch policy to the github-pages environment (#3276).
